drones.name: Pyrotechnics Drone
drones.text: This drone can drop mines that explode on command (starship mine: 2d8 fire or piercing damage, basic Reflex save against your class DC).

drones.name: Scramble Drone
drones.text: A drone that launches flares that confuse enemy sensors; grants station actions to the drone console while deployed.

drones.name: Repair Drone
drones.text: A drone that restores Hull Points; grants the Repair Hull station action to the drone console while deployed.
